title: Sweet Genius
description:
S02 E10 — Serpentine Genius
A fright in the dessert round; a common vegetable in the candy test; retro music box; genius cake with stinky cheese.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S02 E11 — Glowing Genius
Contestants get a cuddly inspiration and a sticky surprise for use in a candy dessert; two chefs must create water-inspired cakes with Japanese candy and grape leaves.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S02 E12 — Lofty Genius
Animal inspiration and breakfast cereal ingredient in chocolate dessert; candy art; retro hairstyle in the final cake test.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S02 E13 — Plane Genius
Chocolate desserts made from an exotic fruit and a ballpark favorite; British staple for the candy test; medieval duel in the final test.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E01 — Cuckoo Genius
First test, the chefs are inspired by canine cuteness; second test, peanuts and a sweet drink; third test, a chiming object gets the chefs' imaginations ticking.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E02 — Halloween Genius
A chocolate dessert from an Asian drink and dried fungi; onions and a strong-flavored candy; black radishes and mini ice cream cones.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E03 — Heated Genius
An erupting volcano is the inspiration for the first test; the second test, the chefs have to combine an oversized treat with a green mash; the third test is making a berry drink and matzo into cakes.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E04 — Wicked Genius
Sweet fruit filling and chorizo in chocolate desserts; pizza dough and chicory coffee; cakes from sticky spread and a colorful veggie.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E05 — Turkey Genius
In the candy test, the chefs must use barbecue sauce and snack mix as mandatory ingredients; with $10,000 and the title of Sweet Genius on the line, the two remaining chefs confront fear-inducing inspiration and two unusual cake ingredients.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E06 — Squeaky Genius
A stuntman is the inspiration for show-stopping chocolate dishes with unusual squash and old-fashioned candy; festive candy creations made from a curdled dairy product and a versatile veggie; cakes made from a cookie and a leafy herb; $10,000.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E07 — Holiday Genius
Chef Ron has a host of holiday surprises for the competitors.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E08 — Twinkling Genius
Chocolate desserts from chicken stock and a southern candy treat; candy creations from fennel and juicy fruit.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E09 — Dream Catching Genius
Chewy fruit and hors d'oeuvres in chocolate desserts; a Middle Eastern dip in the candy test; creating a cake out of two mandatory ingredients.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
Electric Genius
Fruity cereal as a mandatory ingredient; candy confections made with a strawberry drink and a yellow pepper; fiesta favorite as an inspiration.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E10 — Sci-Fi Genius
Space-themed desserts from Italian olives and retro candy.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E11 — Samba Genius
The chefs attempt to make excellent chocolate desserts that include one blue and one yellow mandatory ingredient.

title: Sweet Genius
description:
S03 E12 — Wedded Genius
Chocolate desserts with ketchup; a candy test with instant noodles and fruit; marriage themed test.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E01 — Carnivals, Cityscapes and Glowing Cakes
A carnival-themed wedding cake complete with a tunnel of love; a massive edible Hollywood cityscape pleases everyone at a fundraiser; a glow-in-the-dark jellyfish cake; a piñata that looks so real it's hard to believe it's actually a cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E02 — Surprise Filled Cakes
A rancher's birthday party calls for a pair of larger-than-life cowboy boots; the Texas Reptile Zoo celebrates with a realistic snake cake that blows everyone's mind; two special cakes hold hidden surprises.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E03 — Gravity-Defying Musical Cakes
A '50s-themed cake with a working jukebox; an out-of-this-world wedding cake gets filled with hand-sculpted edible zombies; an alligator groom's cake; a baker defies gravity with a floating ballet slipper over a stylish baby shower cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E04 — Out Of This World, Upside Down Cakes
An upside-down wedding cake hanging from a chandelier covered in sparkly rhinestones; an edible truck jumps over a Vegas ghost town; planet Earth cake; one baker creates a realistic, 3-D motorcycle cake that's multicolored on the inside.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E05 — Beer, Bling And Spinning Cakes
A brewery celebration calls for kegs made of cake that actually pour beer; an edible sombrero filled with food and flames; an almost life-sized golf cart cake is a hole in one; twins request a spinning birthday cake with extra bling.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E06 — Magical and Mysterious Cakes
Two edible dragons battle it out across a running stream; a sci-fi wedding cake transports the bride and groom to another planet; an office is fooled by an edible, life-sized desk; a cake for an aquarium.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E07 — Castles, Coral and Camo Cakes
A cake from Down Under brings a mermaid and sea creatures to life; revealing a baby's gender with fairytale castle flair; a wedding cake captures the couple's love of deer hunting; a patriotic cake honors military heroes.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S01 E08 — Doughnut Dumbbells and a Wine Fountain Cake
A fountain of wine pours from an edible bottle for a vineyard party; two brothers celebrate their engagements with an elephant cake; dumbbells look like doughnuts; people are shocked when the longhorn skull hanging on the wall is cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E01 — Jaw-Dropping Fantasy Cakes
A cake of Jurassic proportions for a group of movie super fans; a 30th birthday calls for an elaborate dessert, which brings a woodland creature to life; a cake filled with special effects that interact with a video game.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E03 — Oversized, Underwater Cakes
Teachers are over the moon for a spaceship cake filled with cinnamon apples; an oversized pizza cake can barely fit into the restaurant for delivery; an underwater creature comes to life for a third birthday party.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E04 — Realistic Animal Cakes
An unusual animal race has one baker building a cake like no other; a Chinese New Year celebration cake; dinner guests are fooled when dessert comes early; a baker in Texas builds a treat that's so realistic it's hard to tell its cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E05 — Waterfall and Wonder Wheel Cakes
Volunteers are surprised by a yin-and-yang-inspired sweet treat; a bride is overwhelmed with joy when her wedding cake gets its own water feature; a cake design that's big enough for someone to hide inside; a Coney Island celebration.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E06 — Glowing, Patriotic Cakes
Guests at a Vegas party go crazy for a chocolate stout cake; a girl's birthday dreams come true as her favorite pink-haired character comes to life; a veteran's family is celebrated with a patriotic cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E07 — Leprechaun and Mermaid Cakes
A giant leprechaun cake completes a St. Patrick's Day party; one bride's floral fairytale becomes a reality with 2,600 edible homemade flowers; savory dishes that look like anything but cake; a boss makes a cake for an aquarium.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E08 — Spinning, Lifelike Cakes
A flaming fire truck cake comes with a water hose; a produce stand that doesn't include any actual vegetables; an adorable, edible cat is suspended in midair; a wintry wedding cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E09 — Cookies and Feathers Cakes
A baker sculpts a sweet wonderland; the Los Angeles Cookie Con gets a special treat; bridal shower guests don't realize that the table decor is actually the cake; a 40th birthday cake takes flight.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E10 — Ostriches, Tacos and More!
A flightless bird of epic proportions comes to life in Dallas; taco fillings are piled high on a giant confectionary shell; a birthday girl's face is reimagined on a cake; bakers in Las Vegas need a forklift.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E11 — Levitating, Robotic Cake
A levitating wedding cake amazes a room full of guests; a shiny robot cake makes waves in New Jersey; working hydraulics take a car-shaped cake up a notch; a 5-foot tall cake makes a wedding display like no other.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E12 — Bears and Pinball Cakes
Bakers in Texas create an unbearably cool cake that has an element of surprise; a knight in shining armor becomes a cake fit for medieval royalty; a bar mitzvah cake is filled with the celebrant's favorite things; an edible pinball cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S02 E13 — Fiery, Fairytale Cakes
A waterfront wedding cake gets its own functioning river; an island-themed cake erupts with Polynesian flair; a fairytale Vegas wedding cake is taller than the bride; a baker adds fire to a mystical beast.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E01 — Sea Creatures and Corvette Cakes
Young buccaneers are treated to a cake filled with treasure; car connoisseurs enjoy a replica cake that is ready to roll; a dessert for a local bagel shop has all the customers fooled.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E02 — Fierce, Festive Cakes
A baker is excited to create a massive shark cake to celebrate Discovery's Shark Week; a bride and groom are floored when their gorgeous wedding cake spins; a casino hits the jackpot.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E03 — Cities, Skates and Jellyfish Cakes
A birthday girl is thrilled with an underwater creature cake; a wedding cake combines two cities into one epic display; a sculpted bust that is ready for the rink; a cook-off between the fire department and the police department.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E04 — Legendary Adventure Cakes
A couple's honeymoon travels inspire an adventure-filled cake; a unique Route 66 cake; a couple is delighted when their massive wedding cake spins; a famous photographer is honored with a cake modeled after his favorite canine.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E05 — Italian Food and Instrument Cakes
A cake to celebrate retiring music teachers is so realistic it looks ready to play a tune; a family reunion cake is topped off with a barrel of crabs; a dress cake with colorful details; a realistic platter of Italian favorites.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E06 — Over-the-Top Birthday Cakes
A magical, spinning cake that's bursting with color and a surprise Sweet 16 cake covered in sparkles and bling; An out-of-this-world cake brings the birthday girl's imagination to life; a cake filled with cute creatures and critters.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E08 — Magical Character Cakes
Artists create a tall chocolate sculpture of a Texas state fair icon; other projects include a birthday cake featuring realistic fairies and a large-scale cake shaped like an Irish bear.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E09 — Fancy Flower and Farm Cakes
A baker designs an epic pop culture wedding cake with a massive dragon; customers in a coffee shop are pleasantly surprised by a sweet creation with an edible mug; a florist's vision comes to life when chocolate petals form one massive rose.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E10 — Flying and Golden Cakes
Bakers make penguins fly on a snowy cake filled with special effects; savory turns sweet when po' boys are made out of cake; Las Vegas bling is taken to another level with gold fondant and handmade sugar flowers; a movie camera cake with popcorn.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E11 — Luxurious and Playful Cakes
Luxurious details and elegant decor make for a most-extravagant wedding cake. Then zoo animals come to life, sugar looks like hand-blown glass, and a duck rides a mechanical bull on a super playful birthday cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E12 — Dinosaurs and Golden Gate Cakes
A baker brings the Diabloceratops back from extinction; wedding dreams come true with a miniature bride and groom lookalike topper; the San Francisco skyline is recreated in a detailed cake.

title: Crazy Cakes
description:
S03 E13 — Big Ben and Wearable Hat Cakes
London comes to Las Vegas in a wedding shower creation; cake and ice cream get a whole new meaning; a spinning masterpiece shines like crystals; a baker creates an unbelievable cake that's a wearable hat.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E01 — The Simpsons
The Simpsons family is throwing a huge bash to celebrate their success and the winning cake maker will have their creation front and center at the event.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E02 — DC Comics
DC Comics is looking for the best cake maker to create a centerpiece for their celebration; judges Ron-Ben Israel and Waylynn Lucas will be joined by Dan DiDio, Geoff Johns and Jim Lee, senior executives and comic book artists for DC Comics.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E03 — The Knot
The winning cake will be featured at a couple's dream wedding where everything has been provided by Theknot.com, except the cake.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E04 — Nintendo
Super Mario Bros video game is being represented in cake form; the winning cake will be featured at a celebration for Nintendo's Mario Maker; Krysta Yang, from Nintendo of America, is on hand to help judge the results.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E05 — Hello Kitty
The bakers vie to have their cake creation featured at the celebration for the launch of Hello Kitty's North American tour; actress Katherine McNamara judges the results.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E06 — Lego
Four bakers piece together LEGO-themed cake creations, with the winner's cake being at the center of a party at LEGO's flagship store; guest Michael McNally, senior director of brand relations for LEGO Group, helps judge the results.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E07 — The Sound of Music
Four cake artists must create a cake that takes inspiration from the movie classic, "The Sound of Music."

title: Cake Wars
description:
S01 E08 — Girl Scouts
Four cake artists compete to have their cake creation at the center of a massive celebration for the Girl Scouts of the USA.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E01 — Star Wars
Four cake makers compete to have their creation front and center at a party celebrating Disney's newest "Star Wars" video game; Vice President of Development for Disney Infinity, John Vignocchi, joins the judging panel.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E02 — Dr. Seuss
A cake artist's creation will be at the center of a celebration honoring children's book author Dr. Seuss and the posthumous publication of his book, "What Pet Should I Get?"

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E03 — Kung Fu Panda 3
The release of the animated movie "Kung Fu Panda 3" is celebrated as four bakers compete to impress the movie's directors.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E04 — Minecraft
The winning cake creation will be the centerpiece at a party celebrating one of the biggest video games of all time, Minecraft; Brand Director for Minecraft, Lydia Winters, is on hand to help the judge the results.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E05 — Valentine's Day
With the help of an expert chocolatier, the four bakers put their heart into their Valentine's Day cake creations; chocolatier Jonathan Grahm joins the judging panel.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E06 — Shark Lagoon
The Aquarium of the Pacific throws a celebration for their Shark Lagoon nights, and the four bakers battle for the chance to have their cake creation be the centerpiece of the party.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E07 — Shrek
DreamWorks Animation is throwing a massive party to celebrate the 15th Anniversary of the iconic animated film, "Shrek"; producer Gina Shay helps judge the baker's creations.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E08 — Party Animals
Four bakers are challenged with creating amazing cake creations celebrating the first birthday of Rosie the baby hippo from the Los Angeles Zoo.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E09 — Sesame Street
Four cake makers compete to have their creation at the center of an epic party celebrating the latest season of Sesame Street.

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E10 — Willy Wonka
The bakers compete to have their scrumdiddlyumptious cake creation at the center of an event celebrating the 45th anniversary of the all-time classic film "Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory."

title: Cake Wars
description:
S02 E11 — Archie
Archie, Jughead, Betty, Veronica and the whole gang are headed for Cake Wars, as four master cake artists battle to have their creations at the center of a party celebrating 75 years of the iconic comic book.

title: Halloween's Most Extreme
description: The best of what Halloween has to offer.

title: Halloween Crazy
description: The hosts shed light on the creative masterminds who transform ordinary spaces and materials into the spookiest Halloween exhibitions across the United States.

title: Halloween Craziest
description: America's scariest haunted houses in San Diego; coffin race in Colorado; the ultimate custom body painting studio.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description:
S01 E01 — It's Alive!
The bakers design cakes with a dead-to-alive theme, mixing ingredients that are dead and dark with those that are alive and colorful; one competitor's cake is deemed dead on arrival; the remaining three bakers head home to create their showstoppers.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description:
S01 E02 — Cursed!
The four competing bakers must beware of evil spells as Duff Goldman provides cursed ingredients like blood oranges, black garlic and forbidden rice in the first round challenge.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description:
S01 E03 — Infestation!
A swarm of creepy crawlies is on the menu as Duff Goldman challenges the bakers to create cakes that have become infested and decayed.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description:
S01 E04 — Monster Wedding!
Duff Goldman officiates the monster of all wedding cake competitions as the bakers create cakes fit for monstrous matrimony; following an elimination, the remaining three competitors return to their home bakeries to craft monster-sized cakes.

title: Halloween Cake-Off
description:
Spooky Cakes
Duff Goldman welcomes talented bakers to an unconventional baking and design competition; in the first challenge, the four bakers must create Halloween-themed cakes that incorporate a surprise selection of candies and treats.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S01 E01 — Trick or Treats
In the first challenge, the bakers battle it out to create the best creepy cupcakes; the second challenge consists of classic costume desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S01 E02 — Monster Mashups
The bakers spook the judges with their sculpted scary treats and then mash up flavors and themes to create devilishly delicious desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S01 E03 — Field of Screams
The remaining five bakers whip up creepy, dangerous donuts; in the main challenge, the bakers dig deep to create graveyard pumpkin desserts that are to die for.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S01 E04 — Haunted House Party
The final four bakers bake it out in a haunted house cake battle.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S02 E01 — Monsters, Monsters, Monsters
Seven bakers must create creepy bite-sized monster treats; in the main heat, zombies attack as the bakers try to whip up a zombie dessert that makes the judges hungry for a bite.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S02 E02 — Cravings From the Grave
Six remaining bakers must make a Halloween mummy dessert using pre-made pie dough; the bakers must create a candy-stuffed, wicked cake based on a Halloween icon.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S02 E03 — Haunted Circus
Things get spookier when the five bakers left in the competition must head to the haunted circus to create a dozen scary clown cake pops; the bakers make frighteningly strange mash-up desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S02 E04 — Spirits Rising
The four remaining bakers create tomb-themed desserts; the bakers make a dessert inspired by the colorful artistry and spirit of Mexico's Día de los Muertos, or Day of the Dead; the winners move on to the Halloween Baking Championship finale.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S02 E05 — Ginger Dead House
The final three bakers must fill a haunted tree with decorated Halloween cookies; the bakers have just six hours to construct a spooky ginger dead house; special guest Duff Goldman stops by; the baker with the most impressive house wins $25,000.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E01 — Filled With Surprises
Eight bakers show off their decorating skills by creating Halloween candy-filled cookies; for the main heat, it's oozy fun with sublime slime desserts where bakers can make any treat, but it must be filled with a gooey slime.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E02 — Bewitching Treats
Seven remaining bakers must make witches' fingers and toes and create a sauce to dip them in; the witch theme goes a step further in the main heat when the bakers must create desserts that look like witches, complete with edible brooms.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E03 — It's All In Your Head
Bakers work in teams and put their minds together to create the most outrageous and delicious left brain/right brain desserts; in the main heat, the bakers face their fears by using common phobias like insects and ghosts as inspirations for desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E04 — Sweet Screams
Five remaining bakers take a light, sweet and utterly harmless dessert and head to the dark side; it's a main heat filled with frights as the bakers make scary mask desserts to spook the judges; one baker is eliminated at the end of the round.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E05 — The Candyman Cometh
Four remaining bakers attempt to make desserts that taste like their favorite candy bars; bakers must create a dessert that combines chocolate with odd ingredients; one baker is eliminated.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S03 E06 — Extreme Halloween
The remaining bakers must make a glowing edible centerpiece and three accompanying creepy treats for a dessert bar.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S04 E01 — Hidden Halloween Horrors
The competition begins with a difficult pre-heat as the eight Halloween bakers weave spider web desserts with creatures inside; wily witch hunter John Henson challenges the bakers to create melting desserts that reveal a Halloween item inside.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S04 E02 — Fall Forward Desserts
In the "Silence of the Yams" pre-heat challenge, bakers make yam desserts that evoke classic scary movie cliches from chainsaws and hockey masks to bloody knives and creepy dolls; bakers create a pumpkin patch out of mini bundt cakes.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
Best of Halloween Baking Championship
John Henson takes a sugar-fueled look back at some of the most outrageous moments and disgustingly delicious desserts, including creepy-crawly critters, bloodiest baking, spine-tingling ingredients, comedy of horrors and top 10 judges' costumes.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S04 E03 — Monster Mania
A monster has ransacked the kitchen and is on the loose; the bakers work together in the pre-heat challenge to create a 3-D suspect sketch out of pate a choux; the sketch helps put the monster behind bars, but now he's hungry for the main challenge.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S04 E04 — Hallowedding
It's bridal season for Halloween lovers and since bridal showers often have petit fours, the bakers are creating petit horrors in the pre-heat challenge; in the main heat, each happy couple gets a unique Halloween wedding cake.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S04 E05 — Circus of Dread
Bakers enter the fortune-telling tent at the Circus of Dread in the pre-heat challenge; competitors are tasked with creating tarot card desserts; bakers then enter the Creepy Clown Hall of Fame in the main heat, where they create impressive desserts.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S04 E06 — Cranium Epicurean
Inspired by a skull man, the bakers enter the graveyard to bring skull desserts to life in the pre-heat; for the main heat, the bakers must create a nightmare cake based on common nightmare themes; the bakers must face their fears to come out on top.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S05 E01 — Halloween Invasion
John Henson kicks off the competition by revealing all the skeletons in his family's closet to inspire the eight bakers as they make scary skeleton desserts; the main heat is monster madness as the bakers conjure up monster-under-the-bed creations.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S05 E02 — Smells Like Halloween Spirit
The bakers use fresh flavors and colorful decorations to bring old desserts back to life and impress the judges in the Day of the Dead main heat.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S05 E03 — All Things Weird and Wonderful
The six remaining bakers team up to create desserts that pay tribute to the iconic Addams Family; the wonderfully creepy family is honored with dead velvet cakes, and the judges determine who's spooky enough to move on to the next round.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S05 E04 — Creepy and Crusty Creations
John Henson's mummy issues inspire the challenge of crêpe cakes, and judges decide on the creepiest; in the main heat, the five remaining bakers use classic fall ingredients to create jack-o'-lantern pies that are half scary and half sweet.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S05 E05 — Gravely Delicious Desserts
The remaining four bakers go digging to create terrifyingly tasty grave-robber desserts; for the main heat, it's a night at the cemetery as the competitors sculpt marbled tomb cakes to impress the judges.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S05 E06 — A Haunting We Will Go
Host John Henson instructs the three remaining bakers to construct a Ghostembouche, or ghostly version of a croquembouche tower; then they face the final challenge of creating a bleeding zombie cake for the judges.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S06 E01 — House of Haunts
The 10 competitors get their first challenge: haunted house cakes and play the dagger game for the chance at a key reward.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S06 E02 — Sweet Illusions
Carla Hall challenges the nine competitors to create Halloween candy croquembouche and incorporate an illusion; judges Stephanie Boswell and Zac Young decide which competitors' creation earns the win.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S06 E03 — Bloody Good Smorgasbord
For a vampire party, Carla Hall asks the eight remaining bakers to team up and create desserts to satisfy some bloodsuckers.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S06 E04 — Ashes, Ashes, We All Fall Down
The seven remaining bakers enter the creepy nursery; Carla Hall challenges the competitors to bake 3-D demon doll cakes with a diabolically assigned flavor.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S06 E05 — The Devil Made Me Do It
In the devil's den, Carla Hall challenges the six remaining bakers to conjure up a devilish dessert using ingredients, such as sauerkraut, beets, tamarind paste and canned tomato soup.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S06 E06 — The Costume Ball
Carla Hall invites the five remaining bakers to a party in the haunted ballroom, where they must create impressive costume cakes for a spot in the finale.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S06 E07 — The Doctor Will See You Now
The final four bakers make severed limb cakes and floating cakes.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S07 E01 — Welcome to Camp Devil's Food Lake
Ten bakers pay tribute to 1980s classic slasher movies at Camp Devil's Food Lake; the competitors tackle cereal killer pies and mega cakes to impress judges Stephanie Boswell, Carla Hall and Zac Young.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S07 E02 — Back From the Dead
John Henson welcomes some unexpected visitors at Camp Devil's Food Lake to shake up the competition for the eight bakers; pairs tackle creepy cookies from home and a mother of a blind cake bake.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S07 E03 — Bat in Black
The competition gets tougher at Camp Devil's Food Lake as the host challenges the bakers to make creepy cupcakes and a British classic.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S07 E04 — Don't B-Negative
John Henson asks the seven remaining bakers to reimagine a classic dessert; the competitors tackle a trending cake design that must leave the judges' blood running cold if they want to survive another week.

title: Halloween Baking Championship
description:
S07 E05 — Dance Your Life Away
It's prom night at Camp Devil's Food Lake, and host John Henson puts the six remaining bakers in charge of the party snacks; a tsunami of terror claims one more victim from the competition with help from Stephanie Boswell, Carla Hall and Zac Young.
